---
title: "Mesh, FEM and adaptive history"
description: "Expose the actual discretization and solver-specific refinement evidence."
sidebar: simulation
---

SCGSim must expose the mesh and adaptive calculation used for the requested
quantity. A completed solve and a small algebraic residual are not the same
as adequate geometric or field resolution.

## Input supplied by the case

- Source dimensions, holes, contacts and curve intent.
- Requested local/bulk mesh treatment and element/FEM order where applicable.
- Backend-specific adaptation settings, requested modes/frequencies and retained fields.
- Which physical quantity's history must be shown: C, mode frequency, participation or S-data.

Mesh settings are simulation choices, not inferred fabrication rules.

## Backend workflows

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Palace

1. Produce the selected Gmsh geometry/mesh with visible boundary/material groups.
2. Record geometric order separately from FEM order; retain the actual high-order operation and resulting mesh.
3. Execute the configured solve/refinement sequence with native exit and warnings.
4. Return actual elements/DOFs when recorded, per-iteration quantities and AMR indicators; distinguish eigenpair residuals from adaptation indicators.
5. Show final mesh selection and source-linked coordinates when local curvature/contact evidence is requested.

### AEDT

| Family | Required adaptive readout |
| --- | --- |
| HFSS Eigenmode | Mode frequency/error per available pass, mesh growth, mode count and stop reason |
| HFSS Driven | Adaptive delta-S/pass history separately from frequency-sweep completion and port-mode calculation |
| Q3D / Q2D | Matrix-family/conductor error and pass history, frequencies, enabled analysis families and stop reason |

Native geometry/material/mesh-operation assignments must be readable before
the history is interpreted. AEDT adaptation must not be described using
Palace FEM-order or AMR-indicator labels.

:::

## Final product to inspect

Applied-control summary, actual mesh/model views and family-specific history
plots with units, pass labels and missing values retained. Do not fabricate a
trend from one sample or call configured stop criteria a scientific accuracy
guarantee.

Candidates: square pad for basic discretization, disk/annulus for curved
boundaries, and bump/airbridge coupons for interfaces.
[Source views](../../public-pdk-examples/test-components.md).

::: {.callout-note title="Read the mesh beside the requested quantity"}

Use [CircularPad Palace Eigenmode](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/CircularPad/palace_eigenmode.ipynb)
for curved-boundary geometry and mode/participation history.
[SimplePad Palace Electrostatic](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_electrostatic.ipynb)
and [SimplePad Palace Eigenmode](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/palace_eigenmode.ipynb)
provide the simpler capacitance and mode cases. Inspect the saved mesh's
element types, boundary membership and selected local coordinates before
interpreting the returned refinement history.

:::

An order-two label is not curvature evidence: inspect midside placement and
connectivity against the intended boundary. Keep geometric order, field/FEM
order and the observed change in the requested quantity separate. Frequency
history cannot stand in for participation history, and neither supplies a
universal adequacy threshold.

Serves [capacitance](../requirements/electrostatic-capacitance.qmd),
[eigenmode](../requirements/eigenmode.qmd), [EPR](../requirements/epr-loss.qmd)
and [Driven Modal](../requirements/driven-modal.qmd).
